title: Ashbury Rewards Elite Recognition: Welcome Points of a Stay
content:
**Rule.** The Ashbury Rewards welcome points of a stay are set as follows.

1. **The stay.** The stay concerned is the stay of the latest base points transaction on the account.
2. **Welcome amount.** The welcome amount is the tier's welcome amenity points at Ashbury Hotel, Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve hotels and the tier's select-service welcome amenity points at Ashbury Express and Ashbury Inn & Suites hotels. The brand is the hotel brand on the stay's reservation.
3. **Welcome points.** The welcome points are the welcome amount, once for the stay.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays)

| Tier | Brand | Tier's welcome figure for that brand group, taken as | Welcome points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gold Elite | Ashbury Resort & Spa | 500 | 500 |
| Gold Elite | Ashbury Express | 250 | 250 |
| Platinum Elite | Ashbury Inn & Suites | 500 | 500 |
| Silver Elite | Ashbury Reserve | 0 | 0 |
